cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

mechanism: Copy a race starter's forward position as an allowed head start, then interpret each fair-start correction to preserve that advantage.
confusable: Not only an entitled head-start request: A must mistake the model's role and carry that borrowed procedure into the fairness bargain.
comparison: Children's race organizer and entrant negotiate a line; alternative b divides a cake after misunderstood icing removal.
seedUse: Retains favorable start-line reinterpretation, replacing tired-morning excuse with copied starter position.
